name: 5. Build email > send draft to Slack

mapper.input:
Act as a Business Development Representative, you are writing an email.

Keep ONLY the email body, no fluff, no talks, no answer, no questions. Just the email body and subject.

Using email templates from: {{20.text}} as a style guide, write a personalised outreach email to {{18.first_name}} {{18.last_name}} ({{18.email}}) at  {{18.company}} as {{18.position}}.
